rawParameters.description:
Raw parameters is an map of multiple pairs of key and values. Each value is an array of specified values for each
occurrance of the parameter in the query string. If a parameter is specified without a value (no `=` sign),
the element is null.

This is the highest fidelity method, but is the hardest to use. For code which does not need to handle flags or
repeated parameters, #stringParameters is more convenient.

title:
UrlQuery type is used for parsing and construct query of URL. Example of query: "ion=1&espv=8". Parameters can
appear multiple times and by convention a parameter without a value (no `=` sign) is interpreted as a flag.

Note that all names and values are URL decoded (for example "%20" is replaced with a space).
name: UrlQuery
